title: Flux Klein edits can use four reference images
summary:
Flux Klein gained four-image editing, seven community projects joined the catalog, and text and image request handling got fixes.

Flux Klein 4B image editing now accepts up to four reference images instead of using only the first. Text-to-image generation is unchanged.

Seven community projects were added, spanning cryptid images, PowerShell image and text examples, financial analysis, saved web highlights, story writing, and bouquet previews. A README update also corrected creator attribution for Daily Cryptid and Parallel.

When an upstream provider returns no content, tool calls, or completion tokens, the text API now returns a 502 error identifying the model instead of passing along an apparently successful empty response.

daily.title: Four-image Flux Klein edits
daily.text: Edit with up to four reference images using Flux Klein 4B, rather than having all but the first ignored. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=Flux%20Klein%204B).
